title: After-hours AI receptionist
desc: An AI voice agent that answers every call at 2am, triages the emergency, quotes the service-call fee, and books the slot — before the caller tries the next name on Google.

title: Missed-call text-back
desc: Phone rings out → caller instantly gets a text: "On a roof right now — what do you need?" Saves the lead you already paid to generate.

title: Speed-to-lead auto-dialer
desc: New form lead triggers your phone to ring and connects you to the prospect within seconds. First responder wins 78% of the time — be the first responder every time.

title: Agentic follow-up SDR
desc: An AI agent that works every unclosed estimate: texts, emails, answers objections, and rebooks — politely relentless for 90 days so you don't have to remember to be.

title: Review engine
desc: Job closes → customer gets a perfectly-timed review ask, unhappy ones get routed to you privately first. Compounds into the map-pack rankings that print money.

title: Quote-follow-up sequences
desc: Estimates that chase themselves: day 2 nudge, day 5 financing option, day 12 "price holds till Friday." Most shops send zero follow-ups; the money is in follow-up three.

title: Job-photo content pipeline
desc: Crew uploads job photos → AI writes the before/after post, tags the city, and publishes to Google Business Profile, Facebook, and Instagram. Marketing that happens while you work.

title: AI photo estimator
desc: Homeowner texts photos, AI drafts a rough scope and price range for your approval. You quote in minutes, not after a week of windshield time.

title: Instant pricing calculator
desc: A "ballpark my project" tool on your site that trades a price range for contact info. Converts researchers into booked estimates while competitors hide their prices.

title: Seasonal reminder engine
desc: Every past customer gets the right nudge at the right month — tune-ups, cleanings, inspections — automatically, forever. Databases beat door-knocking.

title: Referral engine
desc: Post-job flow that makes referring you effortless: shareable link, tracked rewards, automatic thank-yous. Word of mouth, systematized.

title: "We're on your street" radius blitz
desc: Booked job triggers postcards or door-hanger routes to the 50 nearest homes: "Your neighbor on Maple hired us." Social proof with a street address.

title: Truck QR landing pages
desc: Every truck, yard sign, and jobsite banner gets a QR to a page that books instantly — and tells you exactly which truck earned the lead.

title: AI call scoring & coaching
desc: Every inbound call transcribed and scored: booked or lost, why, and what the CSR should say next time. Your phone is a goldmine of coaching data nobody reads.

title: Lead-source truth dashboard
desc: One screen that shows what every lead source actually costs per booked job — not per click. Kills the ad spend that never made you a dollar.

title: Cancellation rebooking agent
desc: Job cancels → an AI agent immediately offers the slot to your waitlist and backfills the schedule. Empty truck hours are the most expensive hours you own.

title: Invoice chase automation
desc: Friendly, escalating payment reminders that run themselves so you never have the awkward call. Cash flow without the chasing.

title: Maintenance-plan portal
desc: Sell recurring memberships — priority service, annual visits, discounts — with self-serve signup, billing, and renewal automation. Revenue you can forecast.

title: Win-back campaigns
desc: Customers who haven't called in 18 months get a reason to. It costs 5× more to buy a stranger than to wake up a past customer.

title: Hiring funnel that runs itself
desc: Landing page, application flow, automated screening questions, and interview scheduling for techs and crews. The labor shortage rewards whoever hires fastest.

title: Jobsite daily-log app
desc: Crews log photos, hours, and blockers from their phone; owners see every job's status without driving to it. Fewer surprises, cleaner handoffs.

title: Storm-response engine
desc: Hail or wind event hits → geo-targeted landing pages, ads, and outreach spin up for the affected zips within hours, while the tarps are still going on.

title: Hail-tracker prospecting
desc: Storm data feeds a map of hit neighborhoods, auto-builds canvassing routes, and preps insurance-ready talking points for the door.

title: Drone roof-report generator
desc: Drone photos in → branded inspection report out: annotated damage, measurements, and a scope the homeowner and adjuster both understand.

title: Insurance-claim copilot
desc: AI that drafts supplements, decodes adjuster letters, and tracks every claim's stage — so restoration jobs stop dying in paperwork.

title: Roof-age prospecting list
desc: Public records + imagery flag homes with 20+ year roofs in your service area. Market to the houses that actually need you this year.

title: Shingle & color visualizer
desc: Homeowner uploads a house photo and sees shingle colors on their own roof. Decision paralysis is where roof sales go to die.

title: Degree-day tune-up triggers
desc: First heat wave or cold snap forecast → tune-up campaigns fire to the right customers automatically. Sell the fix before the breakdown.

title: Filter subscription program
desc: Right-size filters shipped on schedule with your brand on the box. Recurring revenue plus a quarterly reason to be in their home.

title: IAQ upsell calculator
desc: Techs answer five questions in the app, homeowner sees an indoor-air-quality score and options. Turns every maintenance visit into a consult.

title: Emergency triage bot
desc: "No heat" at midnight gets triaged by AI: safety checks, service fee quoted, tech dispatched or first-slot booked. After-hours revenue without after-hours staffing.

title: Water-heater age win-back
desc: Your install records know whose unit is 9+ years old. They get the replacement offer before the cold-shower emergency — and before they Google.

title: Repipe & financing calculator
desc: Big-ticket jobs die on sticker shock. A monthly-payment configurator on the estimate turns "$12,000" into "$140/month" and yes.

title: Drain-care membership
desc: Annual camera inspection + priority emergency response as a subscription. The plumber they're "a member of" is the only one they call.

title: EV-charger install funnel
desc: Landing pages per city + a rebate finder that shows each address its utility incentives. Ride the EV wave with pages nobody else in your market has built.

title: Panel-upgrade estimator
desc: Photo of the panel + a few questions → instant upgrade quote range. The highest-intent electrical lead there is.

title: Generator storm campaigns
desc: Outage-prone zips get standby-generator offers timed to storm season and grid news. Fear of the dark sells prepared comfort.

title: Bill-analysis solar calculator
desc: Prospect uploads a power bill, gets a real savings model for their roof and rates — not a generic national estimate. Trust before the sales call.

title: Incentive finder by address
desc: Federal, state, and utility solar incentives resolved per address, kept current automatically. Complexity is why homeowners stall; kill it.

title: Satellite instant quotes
desc: Draw the lawn, driveway, or fence line on a map and get a price. Quote in 60 seconds what competitors quote in a week.

title: Route-density scheduler
desc: Scheduling that packs jobs by neighborhood instead of first-come order. Same crew, same day, two more jobs — pure margin.

title: Seasonal contract renewals
desc: Snow, mowing, and cleanup contracts that renew themselves with one tap — plus automated upsells when the season turns.

title: Crew-language work orders
desc: Job details, scope photos, and change orders auto-translated for your crews in the language they read best. Fewer redos, faster days.

title: Pest seasonal calendar engine
desc: Ant season, wasp season, rodent season — content and campaigns fire by pest calendar and geography, written once, reused every year.

title: Recurring-plan self-serve portal
desc: Quarterly plans customers can buy, pause, and manage online. Pest control is a subscription business — sell it like one.

title: Broken-spring dispatch flow
desc: "Car trapped in garage" is a same-hour sale. A flow that quotes the fix, dispatches the nearest tech, and texts an ETA — before they call anyone else.

title: Door style configurator
desc: Pick a style, window, and color on a photo of their own house; the configured quote lands in your CRM as a hot lead.

title: Color consultation visualizer
desc: AI repaints their house photo in any palette. Homeowners who can see it, buy it — and share it.

title: HOA repaint-cycle prospecting
desc: HOAs repaint on schedules. A database of communities, cycles, and decision-makers puts you in the room the year the budget exists.

title: Project visualizer intake
desc: Prospects sketch their remodel with AI image tools on your site — then the dream, budget, and timeline arrive in your inbox as a qualified lead.

title: Client portal with draw schedule
desc: Progress photos, selections, change orders, and payment draws in one login. The contractor with the portal looks like the only professional bidding.

title: Punch-list closeout app
desc: Walkthrough items captured as photos, assigned, and checked off — with the final invoice releasing on completion. End the "one more thing" spiral.

title: Public-bid calendar scraper
desc: Every city, county, and school district bid in your region scraped into one feed with deadlines and docs. Never miss a public job again.

title: Utility-locate workflow
desc: 811 tickets, locate statuses, and dig windows tracked against the schedule automatically. No more crews standing around an unmarked yard.

title: Room-visualizer estimator
desc: Upload the room, pick the floor, see it installed, get the estimate. Flooring is bought with the eyes.

title: Builder-partner order portal
desc: A wholesale portal where your builder accounts spec, order, and schedule without phone tag. Become infrastructure, not a vendor.

title: Gutter-guard upsell flow
desc: Every cleaning quote automatically includes the "never clean again" guard option with financing. The upsell is the business.

title: Autumn campaign autopilot
desc: Leaf-season campaigns that launch themselves on the first frost forecast, targeted to tree-dense neighborhoods from prior job data.

title: Hazard-tree report generator
desc: Arborist photos become a branded risk report the homeowner can send their insurance company. Authority closes removals.

title: Stump-grinding route filler
desc: Small jobs auto-batched by neighborhood into gap days. The grinder pays for itself when the routing is smart.

title: Probate & pre-market lead engine
desc: Court records, obituaries, and property data fused into a daily feed of likely sellers — with respectful, compliant outreach sequences attached.

title: Open-house follow-up agent
desc: Every sign-in gets a personal AI-drafted follow-up thread that answers questions and books showings while you're still stacking chairs.

title: Listing-launch content kit
desc: One listing in → property site, reels script, mailers, and ad set out. Every listing becomes a marketing campaign for the next one.

title: Investor deal-flow dashboard
desc: MLS + off-market feeds filtered to your buy box, with rent comps and rehab math attached. Speed wins deals; spreadsheets lose them.

title: Neighborhood authority pages
desc: A programmatic page for every neighborhood you serve — market data, sold stories, local answers — that ranks while competitors fight over one city page.

title: Warranty-expiry win-back
desc: Track every install's warranty clock; as it winds down, the inspection offer goes out. You sold the roof — you should sell its replacement.

title: Permit-data prospecting
desc: New permits in your area reveal who's renovating and who's about to need you next. Public data, private advantage.

title: AI proposal writer
desc: Scope notes in → polished, branded proposal out, with options laddered good/better/best. Options raise average ticket ~30% just by existing.

title: Voice-note job closer
desc: Tech leaves a voice note walking off the job; AI turns it into the invoice, the follow-up, and the review ask. Paperwork dies in the truck.

title: Slow-season demand engine
desc: Your calendar's soft weeks trigger targeted offers to segments most likely to book them. Flatten the season instead of riding it.

title: Competitor-gap SEO machine
desc: Programmatic pages for every service × city combination your competitors never built — hundreds of pages of search real estate, generated and maintained from data.

title: Second-line AI overflow
desc: When the office line is busy or after five rings, an AI picks up as your overflow receptionist. The busiest hour of the day stops being the leakiest.
